entities.summary: Joshua Derek Adam Holden is a former Canadian professional ice hockey centre who is currently the head Coach for HC Davos of the National League (NL) in Switzerland. He was drafted in the first round, 12th overall, by the Vancouver Canucks in the 1996 NHL Entry Draft.
